context.normalized_text: The supplied code is a React `VideoSettings` component using `useState`, `react-hot-toast`, Lucide's `AlertTriangle`, and local `AdvancedOptionToggle`, `Button`, `Input`, and `Label` components.
The component receives the uploaded video URL, the current video URL, setters for those values, and an `onFileUpload` callback supporting image or video file types.
The component tracks whether the URL is a YouTube link, whether YouTube privacy mode is enabled, and whether to display a platform warning.

YouTube privacy-mode toggling extracts a video ID, reports an invalid YouTube URL through a toast when extraction fails, switches between `youtube.com/embed` and `youtube-nocookie.com/embed` URLs, and may call `onFileUpload`.

Adding a video parses the entered URL and uploads the parsed URL when successful; otherwise it displays an unsupported-URL toast. Removing a video clears the temporary video URL and uploads an empty video list.
URL changes are classified against YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, and YouTube no-cookie domains; the handler updates YouTube-link, platform-warning, and privacy-mode state.
The form conditionally presents Add or Remove controls, a platform warning, and a YouTube Privacy Mode toggle.
